# Privacy notice for {BOT NAME}

<!--
A short notice to link from your bot's profile and from the Discord Developer
Portal's privacy-policy field. Replace each {…} with your own words and delete this comment. Check it
against how you set Tavi up: a room whose context you turn on, or a model
provider you change, changes what it should say.
-->

{BOT NAME} is a personal assistant run by {YOUR NAME} with Tavi, on {YOUR NAME}'s own computer. It is not a service run by a company.

## What it reads

- **Messages to it from people {YOUR NAME} allowed.** That means one-to-one messages, and messages in a room {YOUR NAME} added that address the bot: a mention, a reply to it, one of its commands, or a message in a thread it started.
- **The files those people attach.**
- **Recent messages in a room whose context {YOUR NAME} turned on.** When someone addresses the bot there, it also reads up to 20 earlier messages in that room. The room is told before this starts.
- **Your votes on a poll the bot posted,** and who cast them.

It never reads messages from people {YOUR NAME} has not allowed. On Discord their messages are dropped before anything of them is stored; on Telegram a message to the bot from someone new is held, unread by the assistant, until {YOUR NAME} allows or turns them away. Their files are never downloaded, and their words in a room's recent messages are replaced with "[message from someone not known to Tavi]". Messages from other bots and the platform are left out too.

## What it keeps, and where

What it reads is kept on {YOUR NAME}'s computer:
- the messages;
- the files, as untrusted content;
- the notes a conversation taught it.

These are kept until {YOUR NAME} forgets them, or until the bot is removed. Removing the bot erases what it brought in 24 hours later.

To answer, the text of a conversation is sent to the AI model provider {YOUR NAME} uses ({MODEL PROVIDER}), under that provider's terms. Tavi does not use your messages to train any model, and does not sell or share them with anyone else.

## Asking for your data to be deleted

Ask {YOUR NAME} ({HOW TO REACH YOU}). They can erase everything Tavi holds from you on this platform: your messages, your files, your link to them, and the notes your own conversations taught it (`tavi channels forget-sender`).

Your words can also remain in a conversation's saved history, such as a room's history with the bot. Tavi tells {YOUR NAME} which conversations those are, so they can forget them too.

You can also ask {YOUR NAME} to leave you out of a room, or simply not address the bot.
